build.buildCommand: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @tg-calendar/api prisma generate && pnpm --filter @tg-calendar/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @tg-calendar/web build && pnpm --filter @tg-calendar/api build

deploy.startCommand: pnpm --filter @tg-calendar/api prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @tg-calendar/api start:prod
